faqs.question: How do I log in using my Roll Number?
faqs.answer: On the sign-in screen, enter your college Roll Number (e.g. 22CS108 or your registered roll number) in the primary login input field followed by your password. You can also sign in using your registered Gmail or phone number.

faqs.question: How does the Lost & Found automatic email matching work?
faqs.answer: When you report a lost or found item with details (title, category, location, and photo/video), our algorithm analyzes keywords, categories, and campus proximity. When a match score exceeds 75%, an automated alert email is instantly dispatched to your registered mailbox!

faqs.question: How does the Canteen Queue wait-free token system work?
faqs.answer: Browse the digital menu, choose your dishes, and click "Generate Wait-Free Token". A unique token number (e.g., CT-104) is generated instantly, saving you from waiting in queues. You receive an automated token email, live queue tracking, and an audio reminder chime when your order is ready for collection!

faqs.question: How does the Navigation System Voice Assistance work?
faqs.answer: Search or select any campus room, lab, or hall (like TB-305 or Central Canteen) and click the "🔊 Listen Route (Voice Assistance)" button. The portal uses browser speech synthesis to read turn-by-turn walking directions aloud. You can also click the microphone icon to search by voice.

faqs.question: How do I receive my Events and Games admission pass?
faqs.answer: When you register for a hackathon, workshop, or sports tournament (like Cricket or Badminton), your Roll Number and student details are verified, and an official Digital Entry Ticket / Athlete Pass with a unique Pass ID is automatically emailed to your virtual mailbox.

faqs.question: Can I upload videos as proof for complaints and campus issues?
faqs.answer: Yes! Both photos and video clips can be uploaded as evidence for drinking water shortages, broken benches, electrical faults, or mess grievances. You receive an automated email receipt with a tracking ticket number and resolution status updates.

faqs.question: Where can I see all the automated emails sent to me?
faqs.answer: Click the envelope icon (Virtual Mailbox) in the top menu bar anytime. It stores all automated notifications, match alerts, canteen token receipts, and event passes in real time.

faqs.question: How do I contact the emergency Help Desk?
faqs.answer: Click the "Help Desk" button in the top menu bar to access 24/7 campus emergency hotlines (Medical Emergency, Security Gate, Anti-Ragging Cell) and chat with the AI Campus Assistant.
